title: RBI Risk-Based Premium (RBP) for Deposit Insurance

items: Moves from flat 12 paise/₹100 (since 1962) to risk-based; Tier 1 (SCBs ex-RRB) / Tier 2 (RRBs/co-op banks); max risk-model incentive 33.33%, max vintage incentive 25%; effective April 1, 2026; reviewed every 3 years.
